purpose: Compatibility regression guard for the original v1.0.0 math-modeling workflow plus reviewed-change governance for the post-v1.0 extension surface. This is not a cryptographic security or anti-tamper guarantee.

approved_bugfix_reasons.README.md: Synchronize public usage documentation with the real S8 readiness bridge, novice guidance, CLI/Agent boundary, canonical sample and conservative readiness statuses.
approved_bugfix_reasons.CHANGELOG.md: Correct stale/nonexistent script and workflow claims and document the reviewed v1.2 readiness/audit iteration.
approved_bugfix_reasons.VERSION: Advance the project release version to 1.2.0 while leaving the protected legacy SKILL.md frontmatter untouched.
approved_bugfix_reasons.config/pipeline.yaml: Fix invalid YAML syntax in recommendations[0] data-flow paths so the runtime can actually load the configuration.
approved_bugfix_reasons.scripts/run_pipeline.py: Implement executable G1-G6 behavior and connect the logical post-S6 S8 readiness bridge before the final report without pretending Agent-only checks are deterministic.
approved_bugfix_reasons.scripts/report.py: Prevent demo/missing-validation runs from being mislabeled submission-ready and make the optional post-S6 readiness preflight authoritative when present.
approved_bugfix_reasons.scripts/validate.py: Align Finding output with validation.schema.json and correct PASS_WITH_WARNINGS verdict logic so G6 can evaluate real findings.
approved_bugfix_reasons.prompts/README.md: Synchronize the prompt inventory with W/P/J, S8, novice guidance, bridge behavior and compatibility naming conventions.

approved_extension_change_reasons.scripts/check_docs.py: Upgrade static consistency checking to validate every documented script path, prompt inventory and package-less compatibility CLI namespace.
approved_extension_change_reasons.scripts/readiness/run_readiness.py: Remove unnecessary manual required parameters and resolve standard S1-S7 artifacts automatically through pipeline_bridge.
approved_extension_change_reasons.docs/architecture.md: Document the reviewed S8 bridge, Agent/deterministic boundary and extension governance model.
approved_extension_change_reasons.references/troubleshooting.md: Document network/evidence degradation and readiness bridge recovery paths.

protected_semantics: original math-modeling S1-S7 workflow remains available
all original manuscript figures and figure references must be preserved during conversion unless author-approved
all original tables and table references must be preserved during conversion unless author-approved
equations, symbols, definitions, constraints, numerical results, units and uncertainty must not be silently altered
core conclusions and key scientific arguments must not be silently strengthened, weakened, removed or invented
missing evidence and unverified references must remain explicit rather than being fabricated
Agent-only semantic/visual/reviewer checks must not be represented as deterministic PASS artifacts
READY_FOR_HUMAN_SUBMISSION_CHECK is the strongest automated readiness label and is not an acceptance guarantee
